Definition: Extent to which the national digital identity system is integrated with the data exchange for identity verification and authentication
Comments: 6.4 million people have a National Identification Number (NIN). NCRA has established Tier 3 data center. Open-source biometric platform piloted with MOSIP. Civil registration is integrating with national ID. National Civil Registration Act 2016 mandates use of NIN. Telecom and banking sectors connecting to national ID. Digital farmer registry integration with NIN underway (May 2025). However, under half a million ID cards issued and full integration across all sectors is under development.

Definition: Whether primary laws, acts, or legal instruments exist that establish authority for cross-government data sharing and govern the data exchange system
Comments: Data Protection and Right to Access Information Bill 2025 completed national validation (November 7, 2025) and awaits Cabinet and Parliament. Sierra Leone currently lacks a dedicated data protection law. National Civil Registration Act 2016 mandates use of NIN as unique identifier. Telecommunications Act 2006 and ICT Policy 2017 provide partial legislative framework. Enabling legislation is under development.

Definition: Whether a formal strategy or policy document exists specifically for government data exchange and interoperability
Comments: National Innovation and Digital Strategy (NIDS) 2019-2029 explicitly includes interoperability standards, e-government, and data exchange as pillars. An interoperability roadmap for PFM systems is under development (IWG established 2024). The World Bank Sierra Leone Digital Transformation Project (SLDTP, 2022-2027) includes 'Laying Key Foundations for Digital Government Services.' Data exchange is covered within broader DPI/digital strategy but not in a standalone comprehensive strategy.

Definition: Is artificial intelligence integrated into the data exchange for data quality, fraud detection or predictive analytics
Comments: AI for data exchange is planned but not operational. Sierra Leone signed MOU with Qhala (October 2025) to train 500 civil servants and create 10-15 AI-driven government workflows. National AI Readiness Assessment launched October 2025 with World Bank support. National Innovation and Digital Strategy 2019-2029 includes 'Applied AI for Governance' and 'Applied Data Science for Governance' as strategic pillars. No AI in existing data exchange system.

Definition: Current operational status of the data exchange system
Comments: No operational government data exchange platform/service bus as of 2025. Core PFM systems (IFMIS, ITAS, ASYCUDA, T24) operate as standalone systems with no GSB. World Bank ToR (2025) confirms 'there is no government service bus (GSB) with universally agreed protocols within the PFM ecosystem.' A GSB prototype (X-Road or similar) is being planned via Japan QII grant (April 2025), with APIs expected to be fully operational by mid-2026. Operational status: planned.

Definition: Extent to which the data exchange enables services accessible to all population groups including persons with disabilities, elderly, low literacy
Comments: NIDS 2019-2029 states 'cognitive, mental, literacy or physical ability of an individual should not exclude them.' SLDTP includes AT digital equipment for persons with disabilities. Internet penetration is 30.4% (2024), up from 12% (2018). 80% of ID system users have low literacy. Cost barriers to ID cards ($6-7) limit access. Accessibility is partial with improvements planned.

Definition: Provisions ensuring national control over government data and protecting against unauthorized foreign access
Comments: Data Protection Bill 2025 awaiting Cabinet and Parliament approval includes data protection provisions. NCRA Tier 3 data center in-country hosts civil registration/ID systems. GSB to be hosted in MoF Data Center. No comprehensive data localization law yet in force. Sierra Leone ranked 172/193 on 2024 UN EGDI (score 0.3042), indicating early-stage digital governance. Limited controls currently in force.

Definition: Extent to which provincial/state and local governments participate in the data exchange
Comments: World Bank SLDTP includes connectivity to local government offices in secondary cities. GSB scope includes Municipal Property Tax System (MPTS) for 22 Local Councils. PFM Smart for local government FMIS under development. Sub-national participation is planned but not yet implemented.

Definition: Whether data exchange infrastructure and services reach rural and remote areas or concentrate in urban centers
Comments: Internet penetration is 30.4% nationally, with significant urban-rural divide. SLDTP specifically targets broadband expansion to underserved rural areas. World Bank supporting solar home systems in 500 schools and 200 health facilities to address electricity access for digital services. Primarily urban digital services currently, with rural expansion underway.
